title: From the Summit of Mount Symper (Na Kliar Symper)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Na kliar u Lum Symper nga khmied sha jngai,
Ki them bad ki madan ki phriang ha khmat;
Ki kshaid ki kynih kum ki kpieng ksiar,
Ba la sdien halor ka ryndang ka Ri.

Ka lyer ba pyngngad ka pynkhih ia ki phlang,
Ki masi ki bam phlang ha ki madan ba jyrngam;
Kane ka dei ka ri ba kordor jong ngi,
Kaba ngi ieit na ka dohnud baroh.
lyrics_english:
From the high windy crest of Mount Symper I look afar,
The valleys and emerald plains unfold before my sight;
The cascading cataracts sparkle like golden beads,
Suspended upon the throat of the motherland.

The cool mountain wind sways the grassy ridges,
The cattle graze peacefully across the meadows;
This is our priceless ancestral homeland,
Which we cherish with all our heart and soul.
